title: Book 3 — Thalia, Chapter 87
paragraphs: Some say this was the contrivance of Oibares, but others say as follows—for the Persians tell the story both ways—that he touched the private parts of this mare with his hands and kept his hand hidden in his trousers; and when at sunrise the horses were about to be let go, this Oibares pulled out his hand and applied it to the nostrils of Darius' horse, and the horse, catching the smell, snorted and neighed.
